lines: Three things, and then I will go back to not talking.

Four gaps under this town. Find them, and then find out which one is not a room.

_note: THE RULE, DELIVERED THE FIRST TIME THE PLAYER STEPS INTO ANY OF THE FOUR GAPS. One script, four tiles, one onceFlag: the room teaches itself once and then shuts up, because a line that fires at every gate turns the Hall's only mechanism into an interruption. The tiles are the gap tiles themselves and not the deck in front of them -- stepping off the boards is the moment worth marking.

lines: The rail stops, the cap glows, and the peat takes your boots to the ankle and no further.
